items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: this is when Jim Russell came in and heard me playing. And he recommended me to garden Natale.

ctx.x: It was a white club. The black people used to sit around the back on Dantese Street in the back end. And they used to hear us playing. I played there about a year. And then I left there. I left there, and this is when Jim Russell came in and heard me playing. And he recommended me to garden Natale. Out at Natale. And so I went out there, started playing a jam session with the gondoliers on Sundays. And that started expanding me as white. A white artist. And then along came Herald Records to record me. And that's…
Was there a conscious transition to playing for all white audiences?
